items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I happened to be playing with Yusef Lateef... I was working with Yusef at a show bar

ctx.x: Yes, New York, I’m sorry. You went to New York to record and then you decided, “This is ultimately my objective, y’all can go back to Detroit if you want to. I’m here.”

Right. I decided... I went down there with Miles. He said, “J.J. likes you, I want you to stay with my band.” He said, “’Trane likes you too.” He says, “Get with the piano player and learn the music.” Then he walked away. But then, a day or two later, he came to the room and he told Yusef. I thought that was awful kind of him because he came to our room, which I shared with Yusef.
